operating_notes.text: An Income Tax Department order under Section 143(3) with a Section 156 demand for AY2023-24, which the company says arose from computation-sheet errors including short credit of prepaid taxes, is being contested via a Section 154 rectificat
FY26 includes MST Group from July 10, 2025 and SweetRush Group from January 9, 2026, so results are not comparable with the prior year.
FY26 exceptional items include a ₹75.26 Cr reversal of St. Charles earnout obligation and a ₹13.53 Cr gratuity past-service cost from new Labour Codes.
FY26 goodwill rose to ₹842.77 Cr from ₹451.92 Cr after the two overseas acquisitions.
AI-enabled revenue accounted for approximately 13% of total revenue in Q4 FY26.
Entered strategic partnership with Visier to provide AI-powered workforce intelligence services with initial implementations in the UK and Europe.
Subsequent to the quarter, acquired 100% membership interest in Bluewater Learning, LLC for up to USD 17.6 million including earnout over five years.
Reclassified unbilled revenue of ₹84.01 Cr as of March 31, 2026 from Other Financial Assets to Trade Receivables.
Acquired 100% of Bluewater Learning, LLC for up to USD 17.6 million including earnout over five years.
Board recommended appointment of Price Waterhouse Chartered Accountants LLP as statutory auditor for five years starting from the 25th AGM in 2027.

timeline.summary: On 23 April 2026, NIIT Learning Systems said it had filed a Section 154 rectification application and a CIT(A) appeal against the AY2023-24 faceless-assessment demand first disclosed on 27 March 2026, which it attributes to computation-sheet errors including short credit of prepaid taxes.
On 7 May 2026, NIIT Learning Systems announced an earnings call for FY26 results on May 12, 2026.

NIIT Learning Systems Limited’s **Mr. Sapnesh Kumar Lalla (Non-Deal Executive Director & CEO)** and **Mr. Kapil Saurabh (Head M&A & Investor Relations)** will host in-person investor roadshow meetings on **May 15, 2026 (9:00 AM–5:00 PM, Mumbai)** per SEBI Regulation 30.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹525.22 Cr, net profit ₹77.11 Cr.
NIIT Learning Systems Limited hosted an investors/analysts call on May 12, 2026, following audited FY2026 results declaration, with audio available via provided link.
On 18 May 2026, NIIT Learning Systems submitted the transcript of the Q4 and FY26 earnings investor call held on 12 May 2026.
On May 19, 2026, NIIT Learning Systems announced a strategic partnership with Visier to offer AI-powered workforce intelligence solutions in the UK and Europe.
On June 6, 2026, NIIT Learning Systems announced a capital restructuring of its step-down subsidiary, NIIT Learning Solutions (Canada) Ltd, to return excess cash.
NIIT Learning Systems posted Q2FY27 consolidated revenue of ₹528.6 Cr and PAT of ₹37.3 Cr, and announced the acquisition of Bluewater Learning for up to USD 17.6 million.
NIIT Learning Systems' US arm acquired 100% of Texas-based Bluewater Learning, LLC for up to USD 17.6 million.

On October 29, 2026, NIIT Learning Systems recommended the appointment of Price Waterhouse Chartered Accountants LLP as statutory auditor for five years from the 25th AGM in 2027, succeeding S. R. Batliboi & Associates LLP.

NIIT Learning Systems Limited hosted an analysts/institutional investor conference call on October 29, 2026, post quarterly unaudited results for Q2 FY27 ending September 30, 2026, with audio available via provided link.
